KISWAHILI ACTIVITIES — TERMLY EXAM #18
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: KISWAHILI ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Hadithi, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Hadithi.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Hadithi.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Hadithi.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Hadithi.

2. When practising asikilize kisa kikisimuliwa., which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to asikilize kisa kikisimuliwa..
   B. Use insults to “practise” asikilize kisa kikisimuliwa..
   C. Copy random text without understanding asikilize kisa kikisimuliwa..
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for asikilize kisa kikisimuliwa..

3. Wingi wa “mtoto” ni: (1 mark)
   A. mitoto
   B. mato
   C. kitoto
   D. watoto

4. When practising Msamiati, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Msamiati.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Msamiati.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Msamiati.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Msamiati.

5. When practising Kuzungumza:Msamiati, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Kuzungumza:Msamiati.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Kuzungumza:Msamiati.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Kuzungumza:Msamiati.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Kuzungumza:Msamiati.

6. When practising Masimulizi, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Masimulizi.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Masimulizi.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Masimulizi.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Masimulizi.

7. When practising huyu na hawa, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for huyu na hawa.
   B. Use insults to “practise” huyu na hawa.
   C. Copy random text without understanding huyu na hawa.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to huyu na hawa.

8. Ni sentensi ipi iliyo sahihi kisarufi? (1 mark)
   A. Kitabu anasoma mwanafunzi kwa.
   B. Anasoma mwanafunzi kitabu ya.
   C. Mwanafunzi anasoma kitabu.
   D. Mwanafunzi anasoma vitabu mzuri.

9. Kinyume cha “refu” ni: (1 mark)
   A. pana
   B. nene
   C. zito
   D. fupi

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
10. In three clear sentences, explain Hadithi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

11. In three clear sentences, explain huyu na hawa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain Msamiati and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Masimulizi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Hadithi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain asikilize kisa kikisimuliwa. and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
